## Actual contribution to today's REI pilot

Additive descendant of the current PR126 HEAD `367db1f18ed9e6ad5cd680e3dbd2a37ecdb0f049`. Source `56db9f2db0746bf571665ef7ac8e216a9df8c3d8`; delivery metadata `1a44ab5fcee11c6a90fa8cc9397e521ed582d868`. No existing HH solver file changed; no merge.

**63 new collisionless non-tilted LRS Bianchi I CONTROL histories actually completed**, zbar20→4,81samples each,5103stored samples,total nfev7998,4sandbox workers. This is NOT the full H/He + ionizing-source reionization pilot. The original REI PR147 CanonicalFVSpecies source `3b85dedce84d37b3e165da00685a8a984950aafe` supplies unchanged equations, DOP853 and quadrature. The control supplies a comparable baseline and tools to the actual coupled owner.

## Implemented

- Explicit full Frobenius Sigma/Pi diagnostics, signed shear/stress/work, correct half-norm sqrt2 conversion and pi_s=DeltaP/3 convention. SI proper-time kappa_t=8piG/c²; no hidden c=1 assumption. General STF tensor postprocessing is not a generic Bianchi I evolution claim.
- One immutable operator/momentum preparation per worker, isolated case states, source-locked donor restore. No new rate fit, interpolation, solver swap or loosened tolerance.
- Vectorized diagnostics compared with scalar formulas on all5103samples.
- Cooperative advisory capacity leases using current affinity/cgroup limits, free RAM and sampled busy CPUs. Other Codex sessions are not a veto; no foreign signals. Ceiling64CPU/128GiB,reserve16GiB,BLAS/OpenMP1. Same-output duplication lock and hash-bound resume.

## Evidence

14unique focused checks:8bridge+4resource+2tensor. The unchanged owner constructor versus reused preparation gives bit-identical selected RHS/17node history. Repeated bridge checks account for4small parity histories, not additional unique tests. Actual pilot resume reused63/63 with0new runs.

Initial coordinate max abs error1.734723475976807e-18; number error0; algebraic H constraint2.220446049250313e-16; positive massive cells;12signed shear reversals on this finite grid. No continuum certificate. No detailed benchmark campaign and no measured NCP speedup. NCP launch count0; the current remote invocation was blocked before execution. Native independent subagent NOT_RUN; actual CAS/alternate-path checks are preserved.

The two final heatmaps use identical color bounds and signed final shear, while axes show initial norm magnitudes. ThreePNG+CSV+allraw63results are in FULL below.

## Survey and preserved completed work

REI253 and HH135 branch names were enumerated, with relevant current PRs/sources/backups from7repos and prior-conversation intake. This is not an audit of every file on every branch. PHYS73's raw return was already adopted by the later PR126; current ZIP/ACK/all4681payload hashes were checked read-only. Completed15jobs,76panels,152inheritedprofiles were not replayed. HH_R10=OFF.

Other conversations report625/81case pilots and a C15coupled owner. Those raw results were not acquired here; do not sum counts or claim independent corroboration. **Next: acquire existing coupled raw results, normalize conventions and deduplicate physical input identities before adding any new sweep.** Do not put unfinished HH physical-rate work on the pilot critical path.
